# Puzzle 010

## Note

- Your graveyard begins as empty.
- The top card of your library is Pious Evangel (the front face of Wayward Disciple). The rest of your library consists of Swamps.

## Your Game State

### Hand

- Trial of Solidarity
  - Mana cost: {2}{W}
  - Enchantment
  - When this enchantment enters, creatures you control get +2/+1 and gain vigilance until end of turn. When a Cartouche you control enters, return this enchantment to its owner's hand.
- Thalia's Lieutenant
  - Mana cost: {1}{W}
  - Creature - Human Soldier, 1/1
  - When this creature enters, put a +1/+1 counter on each other Human you control. Whenever another Human you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
- Doomed Dissenter
  - Mana cost: {1}{B}
  - Creature - Human, 1/1
  - When this creature dies, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
- Dusk // Dawn
  - Mana cost: {2}{W}{W} // {3}{W}{W}
  - Sorcery // Sorcery
  - Dusk: Destroy all creatures with power 3 or greater. Dawn: Aftermath. Return all creature cards with power 2 or less from your graveyard to your hand.

### Battlefield

- Liliana, Death's Majesty
  - Mana cost: {3}{B}{B}
  - Legendary Planeswalker - Liliana, loyalty 5
  - +1: Create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token. Mill two cards. −3: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature is a black Zombie in addition to its other colors and types. −7: Destroy all non-Zombie creatures.
  - modifications
    - Current loyalty: 5.
- Wayward Disciple
  - Creature - Human Cleric, 2/4
  - Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
  - modifications
    - Transformed from Pious Evangel.
- Bontu the Glorified
  - Mana cost: {2}{B}
  - Legendary Creature - God, 4/6
  - Menace, indestructible. Bontu can't attack or block unless a creature died under your control this turn. {1}{B}, Sacrifice another creature: Scry 1. Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
- Defiant Salvager
  - Mana cost: {2}{B}
  - Creature - Aetherborn Artificer, 2/2
  - Sacrifice an artifact or creature: Put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
- 3x Plains
- 2x Swamp

### Graveyard and Exile

- Empty.

### Library

- The top card is Pious Evangel.
  - Mana cost: {2}{W}
  - Creature - Human Cleric, 2/2
  - Whenever this creature or another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life. {2}, {T}, Sacrifice another permanent: Transform this creature.
- The rest of your library consists of Swamps.

## Opponent's Game State

### Life Total

- Opponent's life total: 10.

### Battlefield

- Faithbearer Paladin
  - Mana cost: {4}{W}
  - Creature - Human Knight, 3/4
  - Lifelink.
- Aven Mindcensor
  - Mana cost: {2}{W}
  - Creature - Bird Wizard, 2/1
  - Flash. Flying. If an opponent would search a library, that player searches the top four cards of that library instead.

### Other Zones

- Assume no relevant opponent hand, graveyard, exile, or library contents.

## Objective

Win this turn.
solution_text:
1. Cast Doomed Dissenter.
2. Sacrifice Doomed Dissenter to Defiant Salvager. Put a +1/+1 counter on the Salvager, and the opponent loses 1 life due to Wayward Disciple. Repeat this effect with the Zombie token made by the Doomed Dissenter. Defiant Salvager is now a 4/4, and your opponent has lost [2 life].
3. Use Liliana's -3 ability to return Doomed Dissenter, and repeat step 2. Defiant Salvager is now a 6/6, and your opponent has lost [+2 = 4 life].
4. Attack with all!
4a. Your opponent's most likely block is to let Bontu through (due to its Menace), and then block Wayward Disciple and Defiant Salvager with one creature each. If they do this, before damage, use Bontu's ability to sacrifice the creature being blocked by Faithbearer Paladin. They will lose [+2 life = 6] (1 from Bontu, 1 from Wayward Disciple's trigger).  When damage is assigned, they gain nothing from the Paladin, and take 4 from Bontu for lethal [+4 = 10].
4b. They may also double-block Bontu. In this case, you can't sacrifice your way out of the Paladin's life gain, but 8 damage will get through, for a total of [+8 - 3 = 9] damage. Post-combat, sacrifice Bontu and Wayward Disciple to the Salvager. (This gets you up to 11, but isn't a puzzlebreaker as it's not the only possibly outcome.)
